messages:
Iris: Quick playful question while we wait for the deploy 
Iris: You're allowed to take one non-work item from someone else's desk in the office mini-swap (they get one of yours in return). What do you pick? Keep answers short.
Jon: Marco's squeaky duck. It's chaotic but makes morning standups better. :duck:
Priya: Keisha's plant (it looks like it actually survives my neglect). :herb:
Marco: I would take the artisanal coffee tin on Jon's desk. Smells like victory. :coffee:
Keisha: The tiny zen garden with the little rake. Two minutes of raking = calm. :sparkles:
Iris: If you had to offer one thing in trade right now, what is it? Single word.
Jon: stickers
Priya: postcard
Marco: cookie
Keisha: pen
SupplyBot: Reminder: desk swaps must follow office property policy. Lost items should be reported within 24 hours. :package:
Iris: Bonus micro-poll : would you participate in a real mini-swap table next Friday? Reply with 'yes' or 'no'
Jon: yes
Priya: yes
Marco: yes
Keisha: no (I'm attached to my zen garden)
Iris: Tally: 3 yes, 1 no. Thanks everyone . Also if anyone actually brings a squeaky duck, please warn us in advance.
Jon: already planning an elaborate squeak-labeled box. :grinning:
Priya: I'll bring a postcard from my last trip. Low commitment, high nostalgia.
Iris: Perfect. Mini-swap logistics thread incoming.
